messages:
Marisol (Finance Ops): Heads-up — temporary change to vendor invoice cutoffs for the next 6 weeks while we close the quarter. Please read and route accordingly.

Marisol (Finance Ops): Effective today: invoices under $7,500 will be processed by Finance Ops without PO if they have manager approval via email. Invoices $7,500–$75,000 require Procurement + manager sign-off. Above $75k — normal approval flow (exec). This is to reduce backlog; exceptions via the form below.

Marisol (Finance Ops): Please send scanned invoices to `finance-invoices@redwood.com` with subject: "Vendor / Invoice / <vendor name> / <PO if available>". Use the intake form: https://redwood.example.com/finance/vendor-invoice-intake

VendorBot: Invoice 987654 ingested for Acme Co. ETA processing: 3 business days. :gear:

Ethan (Eng): Thanks — will tell our contractors to use the email. Quick q: contractors on retainer — do they fall under <$7.5k rule?

Marisol (Finance Ops): Yes — retainer invoices still follow same thresholds. If they're recurring monthly and >$7.5k total/month, mark as Recurring in the intake form.

Priya (Vendor Mgmt): What about pending vendor onboarding that needs KYC before payment?

Avery (Legal): If KYC is incomplete, finance will hold payment even if amount <7.5k. Please flag in the intake form checkbox "KYC complete".

CFO - Daniel: Echo — we've authorized this temporary threshold to clear backlog. Any invoice that looks high-risk should be escalated to me and Legal.

Marisol (Finance Ops): Estimated window: 2026-03-23 to 2026-05-03 (6 weeks). We'll reassess fortnightly and post updates here.

Priya (Vendor Mgmt): Noted. I'll update the vendor onboarding doc and ping the vendor contacts.

Ethan (Eng): :thumbsup: thanks

Marisol (Finance Ops): One note for teams: tag invoices with "PROJECT-CODE" in subject so cost center mapping is automated. Example subject: "Vendor / Invoice / Acme Co / PROJECT-ML-482".

VendorBot: Reminder — duplicate invoice detection running. If you get a false positive DM finance-ops.

Avery (Legal): Also, PMs — don't retroactively change PO terms after approval. Causes rework.

Marisol (Finance Ops): Qs? Otherwise I'll follow up with a short FAQ doc and a short Loom with the intake walkthrough.

Ethan (Eng): Q — is there a temporary change to P-card limits?

Marisol (Finance Ops): No change to P-card policy. For anything that needs immediate payment, request an ACH expedite via the intake form and mark "EXPEDITE".

Priya (Vendor Mgmt): Thanks Marisol, will share vendor comms. :wave:

Marisol (Finance Ops): Thanks team. I'll post the first checkpoint in 2 weeks.
